verdict.rationale: Version history is a fair axis for a design tool like Penpot, but the evidence pack never documents named versions, version comparison, or restoring a file to an earlier state. The only restore-related item covers recreating a deleted main component from a copy, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, full version history lets me name milestones, compare, and restore any earlier state of a file
